CheckTitle: Ensure Assignments of Substantial Access to EPM Administrators Are Monitored
Benchmark: CIS Oracle SaaS Cloud Applications Benchmark v1.0.0
RequiredAccess: EPM Cloud access (EPM Automate, Service Administrator)
Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management (Advanced Controls)
Description: Assignments of EPM roles that expose sensitive account and financial data should be monitored.
Risk: Broad EPM roles let users view sensitive data without oversight.
AuditProcedure: Identify EPM roles with sensitive privileges and inspect their assignments.
Automated alternative: deploy the matching Transaction/Access Controls in Fusion Cloud Applications Risk Management so changes start an investigation workflow. Examples: 4608, 4616.

Steps: Remove unwanted assignments and confirm data-handling compliance.
